functions.buildRegistry: common extensible equipment model (14 categories + category-specific `attributes`); unknown category ⇒ SPECIALIZED (flagged); NO_ID/DUPLICATE_ID rejected
functions.checkAvailability: assignment overlap (DOUBLE_AFFECTATION), RETOUR_MANQUANT, AFFECTATION_INCOHERENTE; recommends only, changes no real assignment
functions.maintenanceAlerts: maintenance/contrôle/assurance échue|proche, COMPTEUR_INCOHERENT, COUT_MAINTENANCE_INHABITUEL (vs median), HISTORIQUE_INCOMPLET; NEVER declares conforme from a document's presence
functions.fuelIndicators: cost-per-unit ONLY when meter delta>0 (else NOT_MEASURED); CONSOMMATION_SANS_JUSTIF/DOUBLON, COMPTEUR_INCOHERENT
functions.computeStock: théorique/disponible/réservé/consommé/en-transit; STOCK_NEGATIF (unless allowed), UNITE_INCOHERENTE, MOUVEMENT_SANS_JUSTIF, TRANSFERT_NON_RECU, RUPTURE_POTENTIELLE; explicit signed adjustments (history never silently modified)
functions.imputeToChantier: §8 CENTRAL — imputes ONLY equipment USAGE (hours×rate) + stock CONSUMPTION (qty×unitCost) as chantier expenses; purchases/receptions are COMMITMENTS, never charges (anti-double-count); feeds chantier-profitability.computeChantier

costModel: radar-grounded (V149_RADAR_PARC_STOCK): coût de revient horaire/journalier = amortissement + maintenance + carburant + location → valorisé par imputation chantier (hours×rate).
antiDoubleCount: PROVEN in test: a 500000 purchase recorded as a commitment does NOT inflate chantier cost (280000 = usage 200000 + consumption 80000); a stock RECEPTION is never imputed as a consumed charge.
demonstrators: 5 §9 parcours (maison pelle/camion/béton; terrassement/TP engins/carburant/enrobés; transfert dépôts; livraison partielle/stock réservé/consommation; panne/immobilisation/maintenance/location) + adversarial (double affectation, compteur régressif, consommation dupliquée, stock négatif, transfert non reçu, livraison excédentaire, pièce sans équipement, contrôle expiré, assurance manquante, dépense sans chantier, unité incompatible, double comptabilisation achat/consommation, données manquantes/devises mélangées) — in the test.
reuseNoParallelArch: feeds chantier-profitability via its `expenses` shape; no parallel fleet/stock/finance system; no 16th métier; no new primitive.
radar: docs/odg/V149_RADAR_PARC_STOCK.json — 1 dated FR query under valid grant (expires 2026-11-19). Confirmed coût-de-revient + chantier imputation model and the parc availability/maintenance/stock scope.
limits: SYNTHETIC data only — never a real parc/fleet/stock measurement
no telematics / GPS / real meter feeds; meters are supplied inputs
regulatory conformity (contrôles/assurances) is signalled, NOT decided — precise requirements remain sourced + expert-validated
indicators are NOT_MEASURED without a valid denominator (no fabricated rate)
no real stock/order/planning/assignment mutation; no supplier contact/order/payment
honesty: P2 is VALIDATED_LOCAL/DEMO_READY, NOT commercialisable from synthetic tests. Reconciliation-grounded chantier cost integration (anti-double-count) is the differentiator. €0 clients; radar prices = HYPOTHESES.
